ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 7:3 ratio of low-intensity (dark charcoal) to high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region; high-intensity white geometric blobs on distal tips of both lobes; extensive white mottling and speckling along the leftmost margin and lower right margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 65-degree interior angle; central depression depth is moderate relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes varying from small jagged points to larger rounded protrusions along the entire visible trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity circular pixel patterns (barnacle scars) localized at the extreme distal tips and along the outer leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (scratches) distributed across the dark pigmented areas, particularly concentrated on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel linear rake marks visible on the left lobe and scattered single linear abrasions across the central ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular reflection (glare) on the right lobe surface and significant atmospheric/water spray occlusion at the fluke-water interface.
